branch.runReviewHint: Asks the agent in the terminal to review this branch against the base branch and deliver the result to Reverik.
branch.reviewPrompt: Review the changes on {head} against {base}. Start with git diff {base}...{head} and read the changed files, then follow the data flows the change touches. Deliver one review file per affected flow to .reverik/reviews/<name>.json as described in .reverik/instructions.md, section Reviews: the flow as it works on {base}, the flow as it works on {head} with the same ids for unchanged nodes and calls, and findings for anything that looks wrong or risky. Do not commit or change anything in the repository. Then summarise the findings in a few sentences.
